gate.filePrompt: Its owner keeps their files encrypted. Enter the file password to open it.
gate.galleryPrompt: This person keeps their files encrypted. Enter the file password to see them.
gate.remember: Remember on this browser for 30 days
gate.rememberHelp: This person's other files will open without asking. Leave it unticked on a computer you share.
gate.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Try again in {minutes, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}}.

settings.title: File encryption
settings.description: Encrypt all of your files with a password of their own. Anybody who opens one of them, you included, types that password once per browser.
settings.offIntro: Your files are stored as they are. With encryption on, every file you have and upload is stored encrypted, and links to them ask for the file password.

points.uploads: Uploads from the panel, ShareX and the app keep working without the password.
points.links: People you share a link with need the file password too.

settings.enableIntro: Choose the file password. It encrypts every file you have now and every file you upload later.
settings.passwordHelp: At least {min} characters, and not the password you sign in with: people you share links with will type this one.
settings.warningTitle: A forgotten password means lost files
settings.warning: Nobody can recover your files without this password: not you, not an administrator, not a password reset. Keep it somewhere safe.
settings.acknowledge: I understand that my files cannot be recovered without this password
settings.progressNote: Your files stay available meanwhile. If the server restarts, it carries on where it stopped.
settings.allEncrypted: All {total, plural, one {# file is} other {# files are}} encrypted.
settings.lockedHint: Enter the file password to see previews and open your files on this browser.
settings.changeNote: Every browser and app that remembers the password will have to enter the new one. Your files stay as they are.
settings.disableNote: Your files will be decrypted and stored as they were before, and links will stop asking for the password.
settings.grantsTitle: Browsers and apps that remember the password
settings.pending: Some files could not be processed yet. They will be tried again shortly.

error.rate-limited: Too many attempts. Try again in a few minutes.
error.same-as-sign-in: Use a different password than the one you sign in with.
error.not-acknowledged: Confirm that you understand the warning.
error.busy: Your files are still being decrypted. Try again when it has finished.

toast.enabled: Encryption is on. Your files are being encrypted.

banner.title: Your files are encrypted
banner.text: Enter the file password to see previews and open your files on this browser.

admin.notice: This account's files are encrypted. Administrators cannot open, preview or download them; names, sizes and dates stay visible.
